stimuli.title: Esha, Pia, Lata, Hema, Bina, Isha, Riya, Kiran occupy eight flats on floors 1 (bottom) to 4 (top). Each floor has Flat A to the west of Flat B. Each flat has one resident. For ordering only, count Floor 1 A, Floor 1 B, Floor 2 A, Floor 2 B, and so on.
stimuli.body:

• Esha occupies floor 3, flat B.
• The floor numbers of Pia and Riya differ by 2.
• Hema and Isha occupy flats with the same letter on different floors.
• Bina lives below Riya.
• The floor numbers of Hema and Bina differ by 3.
• Bina lives in Flat A.

• The floor numbers of Bina and Kiran differ by 3.

questions.stem:
In a substitution language, each word has one distinct code. Code order is arbitrary.
digital rural credit = ze su ni
digital savings banking = vo to ni
rural savings access = vo ka su
credit banking access = to ze ka
digital rural access = ni su ka
What is the code for “digital”?
questions.explanation: Answer: ni. Compare the intersections of the coded lines. The complete consistent mapping is: digital = ni, rural = su, credit = ze, savings = vo, banking = to, access = ka.

questions.stem: A surveyor walks 95 km east, turns right and walks 204 km, then turns right and walks 10 km. What is the shortest distance (km) from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Answer: 221. The first and third legs oppose each other. Net components are 85 km along the initial direction and 204 km perpendicular to it. Distance = √(85² + 204²) = 221 km.

questions.stem: A surveyor walks 89 km north, turns left and walks 180 km, then turns left and walks 14 km. What is the shortest distance (km) from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Answer: 195. The first and third legs oppose each other. Net components are 75 km along the initial direction and 180 km perpendicular to it. Distance = √(75² + 180²) = 195 km.

questions.stem: A surveyor walks 46 km west, turns left and walks 60 km, then turns left and walks 21 km. What is the shortest distance (km) from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Answer: 65. The first and third legs oppose each other. Net components are 25 km along the initial direction and 60 km perpendicular to it. Distance = √(25² + 60²) = 65 km.

questions.stem: E is the mother of H. C is the daughter of H. D is the father of H. How is C related to D?
questions.explanation: Answer: Granddaughter. D is a parent of H, and C is H’s daughter. Hence C is D’s grandchild.

questions.stem: F is the brother of A. A is the mother of B. G is the father of F and A. How is F related to B?
questions.explanation: Answer: Maternal uncle. F is the brother of B’s mother A. Therefore F is the maternal uncle.

questions.stem: C is the only daughter of E. E is the father of C. A is the son of C. H is the sister of E. How is E related to A?
questions.explanation: Answer: Maternal grandfather. E is the father of C, and C is A’s mother. Thus E is the maternal grandfather.

questions.stem: In a queue of 41 candidates, a candidate is 9th from the front. After moving 3 places towards the back, what is the candidate’s rank from the back?
questions.explanation: Answer: 30. New front rank = 9+3 = 12. Back rank = 41 − 12 + 1 = 30.

questions.stem: In a queue of 43 candidates, a candidate is 19th from the front. After moving 4 places towards the back, what is the candidate’s rank from the back?
questions.explanation: Answer: 21. New front rank = 19+4 = 23. Back rank = 43 − 23 + 1 = 21.

questions.stem: Two articles are sold for ₹2600 each. One earns 10% profit and the other incurs 25% loss. Find the combined cost price (₹, to two decimals).
questions.explanation: Answer: 5830.3. Recover each cost separately: 2600×100/110 + 2600×100/75. Equal selling prices do not imply equal costs.

questions.stem: Two inlet pipes can fill a tank in 66 and 99 hours. An outlet empties it in 198 hours. All three open together. Find the time (hours) to fill the empty tank. (Round to two decimal places if needed.)
questions.explanation: Answer: 49.5. Net rate = 1/66 + 1/99 − 1/198 = 2/99 tank/hour. Required time = 49.5 hours.

questions.stem: A boat covers 132 km in still water in 6 hours. If the stream flows at 2 km/h, how far (km) can it travel upstream in 3 hours?
questions.explanation: Answer: 60. Still-water speed = 22 km/h. Upstream speed = 22 − 2. Distance = speed × 3.

questions.stem: A and B invest in ratio 5:6. A invests for 12 months; B joins later and invests for 7 months. A receives ₹90000 profit. What is the total profit (₹)?
questions.explanation: Answer: 153000. Profit ratio is 60:42. Each ratio unit = ₹1500. Total = 102 × 1500.

questions.stem: A sum of ₹28000 earns ₹8400 simple interest in 3 years. At the same annual rate, what would be the amount (₹) after 2 years with annual compounding?
questions.explanation: Answer: 33880. Rate = interest ×100/(principal ×3) = 10%. Compound amount = 28000 × (1 + 10/100)².

questions.stem: A container holds 130 litres of pure milk. 26 litres are removed and replaced with water. This process is repeated once more, mixing thoroughly each time. How many litres of milk remain? (Round to two decimal places if needed.)
questions.explanation: Answer: 83.2. Each replacement retains 4/5 of the milk. Remaining milk = 130 × (4/5)².

questions.stem: The average weight of 29 people is 45 kg. One person joins and the average rises by 1 kg. Find the new person’s weight (kg).
questions.explanation: Answer: 75. New total minus old total = (29+1)×(45+1) − 29×45 = 75.

questions.stem: A is twice as old as B. After 18 years their ages will be in ratio 3:2. What is the present sum of their ages?
questions.explanation: Answer: 54. Let B = x, A = 2x. (2x+18)/(x+18) = 3/2 gives x = 18. Present sum = 3x.

questions.stem: A 250 m train moving at 82.8 km/h overtakes a runner moving in the same direction at 7.2 km/h. Find the time (seconds, to two decimals) to pass the runner.
questions.explanation: Answer: 11.9. Relative speed = (82.8 − 7.2) ×5/18 = 21 m/s. Time = 250/21.

questions.stem: The price of a commodity increases by 50%. A household keeps spending fixed at ₹2600. By what percentage must consumption decrease? (Round to two decimals.)
questions.explanation: Answer: 33.33. New quantity / old quantity = 100/150. Reduction percentage = 50/150 ×100.
